meta.name: IS Copilot Demo Dataset
meta.disclaimer: DEMO DATASET. Standard numbers and titles are representative metadata compiled for demonstration; scope summaries are paraphrased descriptions, NOT official standard text. Edition years, amendments and certification mappings are indexed as best-effort demo records and MUST be verified against the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) before any procurement use.

standards.title: Luminaires: Part 5 Particular requirements, Section 3 Luminaires for road and street lighting
standards.scope: Particular requirements for luminaires intended for road and street lighting, used together with the general requirements and tests of IS 10322 (Part 1). Covers pole-mounted and outdoor road lighting luminaires including LED types.

amendments.summary: Representative amendment record for demonstration; verify count and dates with BIS.

standards.title: Luminaires: Part 1 General requirements and tests
standards.scope: General requirements and tests for luminaires incorporating electric light sources, covering classification, marking, construction, protection against electric shock, insulation, creepage, endurance and thermal tests. Applied together with the relevant Part 5 particular requirements.

standards.title: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services: Part 1 Safety requirements
standards.scope: Safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps intended for domestic and similar general lighting purposes, including marking, interchangeability, protection against electric shock, insulation resistance, mechanical strength and thermal considerations.

standards.title: Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services: Part 2 Performance requirements
standards.scope: Performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps, covering lamp power, luminous flux, efficacy, colour characteristics, lumen maintenance and life-related measurements.

standards.title: LED modules for general lighting: Part 1 Safety requirements
standards.scope: Safety requirements for LED modules used in general lighting, including marking, terminals, protective earthing, protection against electric shock, insulation, thermal endurance and fault conditions.

standards.title: LED modules for general lighting: Part 2 Performance requirements
standards.scope: Performance requirements for LED modules, covering rated values, luminous flux, efficacy, colour characteristics and lumen maintenance.

standards.title: Lamp control gear: Part 2 Particular requirements, Section 13 DC or AC supplied electronic control gear for LED modules
standards.scope: Particular safety requirements for electronic control gear (LED drivers) supplied from DC or AC sources for use with LED modules, used together with the general requirements of IS 15885 (Part 1).

standards.title: DC or AC supplied electronic control gear for LED modules: Performance requirements
standards.scope: Performance requirements for electronic control gear for LED modules, covering supply characteristics, output, power factor, harmonic content, endurance and abnormal operation.

standards.title: Method of electrical and photometric measurements of solid-state lighting (LED) products
standards.scope: Test methods for measuring electrical and photometric characteristics of solid-state lighting products, including total luminous flux, electrical power, efficacy, colour characteristics and intensity distribution.

standards.title: Luminaires performance: Part 1 General requirements
standards.scope: General performance requirements for luminaires, including rated values, luminous flux, efficacy, colour characteristics, lumen maintenance and endurance.

standards.title: Code of practice for lighting of public thoroughfares: Parts 1 and 2 General principles and lighting for main and secondary roads
standards.scope: Design guidance for lighting of public roads, including classification of roads, illuminance and uniformity criteria, mounting height, spacing, pole arrangement and glare control.

standards.title: Degrees of protection provided by enclosures (IP Code)
standards.scope: Classification system and tests for degrees of protection provided by enclosures of electrical equipment against ingress of solid objects, dust and water (IP code, e.g. IP65, IP66, IP67).

standards.title: Classification of degrees of protection provided by enclosures of electrical equipment
standards.scope: Earlier Indian classification of enclosure protection degrees (IP code). Recorded in this dataset as superseded by IS/IEC 60529.

standards.title: Electrotechnical vocabulary: Part 16 Lighting
standards.scope: Definitions of terms used in lighting, including photometric quantities, light sources, luminaires and lighting installations.

standards.title: Code of practice for interior illumination: Part 1 General requirements and recommendations for working interiors
standards.scope: Recommendations for lighting of working interiors, including recommended illuminance levels, glare limitation, colour and maintenance considerations.

standards.title: Polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductor for rated voltages up to and including 450/750 V
standards.scope: Requirements for PVC insulated cables and flexible cords for fixed wiring and appliance connections up to 450/750 V, including conductor, insulation, sheath, dimensions, marking and tests.

amendments.summary: Representative amendment record for demonstration; verify with BIS.
Representative amendment record for demonstration; verify with BIS.

standards.title: PVC insulated (heavy duty) electric cables: Part 1 For working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Requirements for PVC insulated heavy-duty power cables up to 1100 V, including armoured and unarmoured constructions, conductor, insulation, sheath and tests.

standards.title: Crosslinked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables: Part 1 For working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Requirements for XLPE insulated, PVC sheathed power cables up to 1100 V, including armoured and unarmoured constructions and tests.

standards.title: Conductors for insulated electric cables and flexible cords
standards.scope: Requirements for solid, stranded and flexible copper and aluminium conductors used in insulated cables and flexible cords, including classes, resistance and construction.

standards.title: PVC insulation and sheath of electric cables
standards.scope: Requirements and tests for PVC compounds used as insulation and sheath of electric cables, including types and physical/thermal properties.

standards.title: Methods of test for cables (series of parts)
standards.scope: Series of test methods for electric cables covering conductor resistance, insulation resistance, high-voltage tests, tensile and elongation, ageing, flammability and other properties.

standards.title: Code of practice for electrical wiring installations
standards.scope: Guidance for design, selection of equipment, erection, inspection and testing of electrical wiring installations in buildings and similar premises.

standards.title: Code of practice for earthing
standards.scope: Guidance on earthing of electrical installations, including earth electrodes, earthing conductors, resistance requirements and measurement.

standards.title: Plugs and socket-outlets of rated voltage up to and including 250 V and rated current up to and including 16 A
standards.scope: Requirements for plugs and socket-outlets for household and similar purposes up to 250 V and 16 A, including construction, dimensions, safety and tests.

standards.title: Electrical accessories - Circuit-breakers for overcurrent protection for household and similar installations: Part 1 Circuit-breakers for AC operation
standards.scope: Requirements for AC miniature circuit-breakers for overcurrent protection in household and similar installations, covering ratings, characteristics and tests.

standards.title: Residual current operated circuit-breakers for household and similar uses: Part 1 Circuit-breakers without integral overcurrent protection (RCCBs)
standards.scope: Requirements for residual current operated circuit-breakers without integral overcurrent protection for household and similar uses.

standards.title: Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies: Part 1 Requirements for type-tested and partially type-tested assemblies
standards.scope: Requirements for low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies including panels and distribution boards, covering construction, ratings, protection and verification.

standards.title: Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear: Part 1 General rules
standards.scope: General rules for low-voltage switchgear and controlgear, including definitions, ratings, service conditions, constructional and performance requirements and tests.

standards.title: Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear: Part 1 General rules
standards.scope: Earlier Indian standard for low-voltage switchgear and controlgear general rules. Recorded in this dataset as superseded by IS/IEC 60947-1.

standards.title: Conduits for electrical installations: Part 1 General requirements
standards.scope: General requirements for conduits and conduit fittings used to protect and route electrical wiring in installations.

standards.title: Power transformers: Part 1 General
standards.scope: General requirements for power transformers including ratings, service conditions, tolerances, tests and marking.

standards.title: Outdoor type oil immersed distribution transformers up to and including 2500 kVA, 33 kV: Part 1 Mineral oil immersed
standards.scope: Requirements for outdoor type mineral-oil immersed distribution transformers up to 2500 kVA and 33 kV, including energy efficiency levels, losses and tests.

standards.title: Hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel
standards.scope: Requirements for hot rolled structural steel plates, sections, bars and flats in various grades, covering chemical composition, mechanical properties and tests.

standards.title: Tubular steel poles for overhead power lines: Part 1 General requirements
standards.scope: General requirements for tubular steel poles used for overhead power lines and similar applications including street lighting supports, covering materials, manufacture, dimensions, loads and tests.

standards.title: Hot-dip zinc coatings on structural steel and other allied products
standards.scope: Requirements for hot-dip galvanized zinc coatings on structural steel and allied products including coating mass, adhesion, uniformity and tests.

standards.title: Design loads (other than earthquake) for buildings and structures - Code of practice: Part 3 Wind loads
standards.scope: Wind loads to be considered in the design of buildings, structures and components such as poles and masts, including basic wind speed, design wind pressure and force coefficients.

standards.title: Plain and reinforced concrete - Code of practice
standards.scope: Code of practice for design and construction of plain and reinforced concrete structures, covering materials, workmanship, durability, structural design and detailing.

amendments.summary: Representative amendment record for demonstration; verify with BIS.

standards.title: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement
standards.scope: Requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires used for concrete reinforcement, including grades, chemical composition, mechanical properties and tests.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland cement - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for ordinary Portland cement of various grades, including chemical and physical requirements, sampling and tests.

standards.title: Coarse and fine aggregate for concrete - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for coarse and fine aggregates from natural and manufactured sources used in concrete, including grading, deleterious materials and tests.

standards.title: Steel tubes, tubulars and other wrought steel fittings: Part 1 Steel tubes
standards.scope: Requirements for welded and seamless steel tubes for water, gas and general engineering purposes, including light, medium and heavy classes and galvanized tubes.

standards.title: Unplasticized PVC pipes for potable water supplies - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for unplasticized PVC pipes for potable water supply, including dimensions, pressure classes, material, marking and tests.

standards.title: Drinking water - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for the quality of drinking water including physical, chemical, bacteriological and toxic substance limits and methods of test.

standards.title: Submersible pumpsets - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for submersible pumpsets for clear, cold water in borewells, covering construction, performance, efficiency, testing and marking.

standards.title: Motors for submersible pumpsets - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for electric motors used in submersible pumpsets, covering ratings, construction, performance and tests.

standards.title: Centrifugally cast (spun) ductile iron pressure pipes for water, gas and sewage - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for centrifugally cast ductile iron pressure pipes for water, gas and sewage, including classes, dimensions, coatings, joints and tests.

standards.title: Code of practice for design and laying of welded steel pipes for water supply
standards.scope: Guidance on design, laying, jointing and testing of welded steel pipelines for water supply.

standards.title: Line operated three phase AC motors (IE code) - Efficiency classes and performance specification
standards.scope: Efficiency classes (IE1 to IE4) and performance requirements for line operated three-phase AC induction motors.

standards.title: Three-phase induction motors - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for three-phase induction motors including ratings, performance, construction, temperature rise and tests.

standards.title: AC static watthour meters, class 1 and 2 - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for AC static (electronic) watthour meters of accuracy class 1 and 2 for measurement of active energy, including construction, accuracy and tests.

standards.title: AC static direct connected watthour smart meter class 1 and 2 - Specification: Part 1 Single phase and three phase whole current
standards.scope: Requirements for direct connected AC static smart watthour meters including metering, communication, tamper detection and tests.

standards.title: Testing, evaluation, installation and maintenance of AC electricity meters - Code of practice
standards.scope: Guidance on acceptance testing, evaluation, installation and maintenance practices for AC electricity meters.

standards.title: Crystalline silicon terrestrial photovoltaic (PV) modules - Design qualification and type approval
standards.scope: Design qualification and type approval requirements and test sequences for crystalline silicon terrestrial PV modules.

standards.title: Photovoltaic (PV) module safety qualification: Part 1 Requirements for construction
standards.scope: Construction requirements for PV modules to provide safe electrical and mechanical operation during their expected lifetime.

standards.title: Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems: Part 2 Particular requirements for inverters
standards.scope: Particular safety requirements for inverters used in photovoltaic power systems, including protection against electric shock, fire and mechanical hazards.

standards.title: Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters - Test procedure of islanding prevention measures
standards.scope: Test procedure for evaluating anti-islanding protection measures of utility-interconnected PV inverters.

standards.title: Information technology equipment - Safety: Part 1 General requirements
standards.scope: Safety requirements for information technology equipment including computers, servers, printers, network equipment and power supplies, covering electric shock, energy hazards, fire, mechanical and heat hazards.

standards.title: Audio, video and similar electronic apparatus - Safety requirements
standards.scope: Safety requirements for audio, video and similar electronic apparatus including televisions, monitors, amplifiers and set-top boxes.

standards.title: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes - Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary cells, and for batteries made from them, for use in portable applications: Part 2 Lithium systems
standards.scope: Safety requirements and tests for portable sealed lithium secondary cells and batteries used in portable applications.

standards.title: Gold and gold alloys, jewellery/artefacts - Fineness and marking - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for fineness grades and marking of gold and gold alloy jewellery and artefacts for hallmarking purposes.

standards.title: Packaged drinking water (other than packaged natural mineral water) - Specification
standards.scope: Requirements for packaged drinking water including treatment, quality parameters, packaging, hygiene and tests.
